lifecycleDiagnostic.method: setImmediate after every twentieth frame, after timing/telemetry/screenshots. CPU timings exclude yield; not wall-frame time, not browser behavior, not a production speedup.

method: Four sequential 600-frame real Canvas runs at deterministic 30 FPS timestamps, 20 sim ticks/sec. Run zero warms process caches. PNG encoding excluded. Frame is CPU sim+snapshot+Canvas drawing, not browser presentation/FPS. Memory is process memory without forced GC; scratchAllocations are cumulative requested RGBA pixel bytes (not resident/native overhead), not live retained bytes. State hashes prove same simulation across runs and before/after.

finalArt.scope: Complete drawWorld Canvas cost includes production combat/projectile updates and ground/body/air rendering. All 600 frames start at tick zero, with every simulation tick observed. Counts are submitted presentation records before viewport culling, not visible pixels or draw calls. Exposure sums record instances across frames, not unique particles. Separate ground-pass timing and JS allocation bytes are unavailable. Diagnostic collection is outside the measured intervals; its retained records contribute to reported process memory. Zero projectile events yields null coverage, not a claim of socket validation.
